```yaml
name: Publish to crates.io

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      crates:
        description: "Comma-separated list of crates to publish (e.g., ic-asset,icx-asset)"
        required: true
        type: string
      dry_run:
        description: "Perform a dry run without publishing"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Publish crates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache cargo git
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Cache cargo target
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-

      - name: Publish crates
        run: |
          IFS=',' read -ra CRATES <<< "${{ github.event.inputs.crates }}"
          for crate in "${CRATES[@]}"; do
            echo "Publishing crate: $crate"
            
            # Determine the path to the crate
            # Assuming standard workspace structure where crates are in root or specific directories
            # We need to find the Cargo.toml for the specific crate
            CARGO_TOML_PATH=$(find . -name "Cargo.toml" -exec grep -l "name = \"$crate\"" {} \; | head -n 1)
            
            if [ -z "$CARGO_TOML_PATH" ]; then
              echo "Error: Could not find Cargo.toml for crate $crate"
              exit 1
            fi
            
            CARGO_DIR=$(dirname "$CARGO_TOML_PATH")
            
            if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run }}" == "true" ]; then
              echo "Dry run: Skipping actual publish for $crate"
              cd "$CARGO_DIR"
              cargo publish --dry-run --allow-dirty
            else
              echo "Publishing $crate to crates.io"
              cd "$CARGO_DIR"
              cargo publish --allow-dirty
            fi
            
            # Sleep to avoid rate limiting
            sleep 5
          done
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
```
